instruction: Implement pricing.charge(units, tiers). units is an integer in 0..1000000. tiers is a list of [cumulative_integer_ceiling_or_null, price_string]; positive finite ceilings must strictly increase, and exactly one null ceiling must be last. Each price is a valid nonnegative decimal string with at most six fractional digits and value <=1000. Apply each marginal unit price only to units within that tier, add with exact decimal arithmetic, and round the final total once to two digits using half-up rounding. Return a string with exactly two decimal digits. Reject empty tiers, nonincreasing/nonpositive ceilings, null before the final tier, missing final null, negative price, or negative units with ValueError. Preserve tiers.
